settings.pdns_text: , it only affects the system resolver (regular name lookups over DNS-over-TLS). Zone transfers (AXFR) and queries to the target’s NS are sent by the scanner’s own DNS client directly over TCP/UDP 53, bypassing “Private DNS”. Mobile carriers, public Wi-Fi or a VPN may block such queries: if AXFR fails, check the network or tunnel.

limits.warn_threads: Above {n} threads the phone heats up and sites block parallel requests more often.
limits.warn_rps: Above {n} req/s many sites block or rate limit you, and the phone heats up.
limits.zero_rps: No speed limit: requests go as fast as the network and threads allow. High risk of being blocked.
limits.warn_hosts: Above {n} hosts at once the scan needs a lot of memory and connections, and a weak phone may get slower.
limits.warn_timeout: Above {n} s a hung server holds the scan up for a long time.
limits.warn_timeout_low: Below {n} s slow servers and Tor will not answer in time.
limits.warn_retries: Above {n} retries the server gets extra load and the scan drags on when the link drops.
limits.warn_mob_low: Below {n} MB the scan pauses almost at once.
limits.zero_mob: No limit: a scan can use up all your mobile data.
limits.warn_batt_low: Below {n}% the phone may switch off in the middle of a scan.
limits.warn_batt_high: Above {n}% the scan pauses often when the phone is not charging.
limits.warn_fuzz_rate: Above {n} req/s the client's site notices the load, and its protection may block your IP.
limits.zero_fuzz_rate: No speed limit: the brute force hits the client's site at full speed, with a high risk of being blocked.
limits.warn_fuzz_requests: Above {n} requests the brute force takes hours and puts noticeable load on the site.
limits.zero_fuzz_requests: No budget: the brute force stops only on the time limit or by hand.
limits.warn_fuzz_time: Above {n} min the brute force keeps the phone and network busy for a long time.
limits.zero_fuzz_time: No time limit: the brute force stops only on the request budget or by hand.
limits.warn_fuzz_hosts: Above {n} addresses the brute force takes longer and loads many sites.
limits.zero_fuzz_hosts: Every web address in scope: on a big scope the brute force takes a very long time.
limits.warn_docs: Above {n} documents the download takes hours and a lot of space.
limits.zero_docs: No limit: everything found is downloaded, which can take hours and gigabytes.
limits.warn_size: Above {n} MB such files are almost always videos or archives and take long to download.
limits.zero_size: No size limit: files of any size are downloaded, but files over 200 MB are not parsed.
limits.warn_depth: Deeper than {n} levels the crawler visits many pages and the scan takes longer.
limits.warn_ocr_pages: Above {n} pages OCR keeps the CPU and battery busy for a long time.
limits.warn_ocr_mb: Above {n} MB OCR of large files is slow and needs a lot of memory.
limits.confirm_hint: The value is saved and the warning stays next to the field. You can go back to a safe value at any time.
